introduction: 2005年法国Clermont-Ferrand电影节最佳短片提名。乌克兰新锐女导演塔拉丝·特卡琴科（Taras Tkachenko）的新作，讲述两个男孩为得到邻村美丽女孩的注意而互相竞争的故事。影片的情节有点类似《西西里的美丽传说》，也是描写少年朦胧的初恋之心，但却没有《西》中那种残酷的现实主义和怀旧气氛，而是用魔幻的手法去描写，整部影片轻松幽默，完全看不到片名中的那么“悲剧”，甚至在表现两个孩子企图以服安眠药自杀来得到女孩留意的时候也没有太多的沉重，而最后的结局是迷人的。其实片中给人印象最深刻的还是异常出色的摄影，镜头拍摄角度和画面构图都很有一种梦境色彩，推荐。（by auess）From Stephen Raks' review, "Tragic Love for Unfaithful Nuska, based on Yuri Vynnychenko's short story "A Grenade for Two," is a sepia-toned film that follows the antics of two young friends as they vie for the attention of the older, beautiful, girl-next-door Nuska. In the first few episodes of the film, the boys spy on Nuska from a distance: from the cover of reeds while she bathes in a pond, from behind a fence as she walks by. Even as their actions progress from voyeurism to poetry-writing, to a suicidal pact, the film maintains an aura of light-hearted innocence …One of the film's greatest strengths is its almost magical realism. The film unfolds as a sort of dreamscape, with each scene achieving its own individual timelessness. Throughout the film, Tkachenko employs unconventional camera angles, and his compositions reveal an impressive sense of depth and space.
